function.description: This function converts a given path into an NT-style path.

parameters.description: The path to be converted into NT-style.

function.return_type: WCHAR *; Returns a pointer to the converted NT-style path.

function.description: This function opens a registry key. It first converts the ASCII name to a Unicode string, then calls reg_open_key with the root key and the Unicode string.

parameters.name: disposition

function.name: reg_create_ascii_key
function.description: This function creates a registry key with a specified name, options, and disposition. The name is converted from ASCII to Unicode before the key is created.

parameters.name: root
parameters.description: The root key under which the new key is created

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the key to be created

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: The options to be used when creating the key

parameters.name: disposition
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives a disposition code

function.return_type: HKEY, which represents the handle to the newly created key

function.name: reg_open_hkcu_key
function.description: This function opens a registry key with the given name under the HKEY_CURRENT_USER root key.

function.return_type: HKEY, which represents a handle to the opened registry key.

parameters.name: type

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: The data to be set.

function.name: set_reg_ascii_value
function.description: This function sets the value of a registry key. It first converts the ASCII name and value to Unicode, then sets the registry key value.

parameters.description: This is the handle to an open registry key.

parameters.name: name

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: This is the data to be stored as the registry value.

function.return_type: void, meaning it does not return a value

function.name: query_reg_value

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the registry value.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to a buffer that receives the value information.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the info buffer.

function.name: query_reg_ascii_value
function.description: This function converts ASCII string to Unicode, then queries the registry value.

parameters.name: hkey
parameters.description: Handle to an open registry key

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the registry value

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that receives the value information

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the info buffer

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the result of the registry query operation

function.name: reg_enum_value
function.description: This function enumerates the values for a given key in the registry. It returns a boolean value indicating the success or failure of the operation.

parameters.name: hkey
parameters.description: A handle to an open registry key.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: The index of the value to be retrieved.

parameters.name: info
parameters.description: A pointer to a buffer that receives the value information.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The size of the info buffer.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A pointer to a buffer that receives the name of the value.

parameters.name: name_size
parameters.description: The size of the name buffer.

function.return_type: BOOL, where TRUE indicates that the function successfully enumerated the value and FALSE indicates that the function failed to enumerate the value.

function.name: reg_delete_value
function.description: This function deletes a value from the registry.

parameters.name: hkey
parameters.description: A handle to an open registry key.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the value to be deleted.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: reg_delete_tree
function.description: This function deletes a registry key and all its subkeys.

parameters.name: parent
parameters.description: Handle to an open registry key.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Pointer to a null-terminated string specifying the name of the registry key to delete.

parameters.name: name_len
parameters.description: Length of the name string.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully deletes the key and all its subkeys, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: get_subst_to_name
function.description: This function returns a pointer to a wide character string that is a part of the 'names' field of the 'gdi_font_subst' structure, starting from the position after the last character of the 'names' string.

parameters.name: subst
parameters.description: A pointer to a 'gdi_font_subst' structure whose 'names' field is used in the function.

function.return_type: WCHAR *, a pointer to a wide character string.

function.name: dump_gdi_font_subst
function.description: This function iterates over the font substitution list and prints the substitution details. If the 'from_charset' or 'to_charset' is not -1, it prints both the charsets along with the names. Otherwise, it only prints the names.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: get_gdi_font_subst
function.description: This function is used to get the substitution of a GDI font. It iterates through a list of font substitutions until it finds a match for the given name and charset, then returns the name of the substitution.

parameters.name: from_name
parameters.description: The name of the font to be substituted.

parameters.name: from_charset
parameters.description: The character set of the font to be substituted.

parameters.name: to_charset
parameters.description: A pointer to an integer where the character set of the substitution will be stored.

function.return_type: WCHAR. It represents the name of the substituted font. If no substitution is found, the function returns NULL.

function.name: add_gdi_font_subst
function.description: This function adds a new font substitution to the gdi_font_subst structure. It checks if the font substitution already exists, if not, it allocates memory for the new substitution, copies the from_name and to_name into the structure, sets the from_charset and to_charset, and adds the new substitution to the font_subst_list.

parameters.name: from_name
parameters.description: Name of the font to be substituted

parameters.name: from_charset
parameters.description: Character set of the font to be substituted

parameters.name: to_name
parameters.description: Name of the font to substitute with

parameters.name: to_charset
parameters.description: Character set of the font to substitute with

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the font substitution was successfully added, FALSE otherwise

function.name: load_gdi_font_subst
function.description: This function loads the GDI font substitution from the registry, and if the charset mapping is valid, it adds the font substitution to the GDI.
function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: family_namecmp
function.description: This function compares two strings and returns a value based on their priority and vertical position.

parameters.name: str1
parameters.description: First string to be compared

parameters.name: str2
parameters.description: Second string to be compared

function.return_type: int, represents the result of the comparison. If the priorities are not equal, it returns the difference between prio1 and prio2. If the vertical positions are not equal, it returns the difference between vert1 and vert2. Otherwise, it returns the result of the facename_compare function.

function.name: family_name_compare
function.description: This function compares a given key with the family name of a given wine_rb_entry structure.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: This is the key to be compared with the family name.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: This is the entry whose family name is to be compared with the key.

function.return_type: int, represents the result of the comparison between the key and the family name. The exact meaning of the return value depends on the implementation of the family_namecmp function.

function.name: family_second_name_compare
function.description: This function compares a key with the second name of a gdi_font_family structure.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: This parameter represents the key to be compared with the second name of the gdi_font_family structure.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: This parameter represents the entry in the wine_rb tree that contains the gdi_font_family structure.

function.return_type: int, represents the result of the comparison between the key and the second name of the gdi_font_family structure. The comparison is done using the family_namecmp function.

function.name: face_full_name_compare
function.description: This function compares the full name of a font face with a key.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: This is the key to be compared with the font face full name.

parameters.name: entry
parameters.description: This is the entry from which the font face is retrieved.

function.return_type: int, represents the result of the comparison between the key and the font face full name.

function.name: face_is_in_full_name_tree
function.description: This function checks if the given face is in the full name tree by checking the parent of the full name entry of the face or if the root of the full name tree is the full name entry of the face.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the face structure that is to be checked if it is in the full name tree.

function.return_type: int, returns 1 if the face is in the full name tree, otherwise 0.

function.name: create_family
function.description: This function creates a new gdi_font_family structure, initializes its fields, and adds it to the family_name_tree and family_second_name_tree if a second name is provided.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The primary name of the font family.

parameters.name: second_name
parameters.description: The secondary name of the font family, if any.

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_family*, representing the newly created font family.

function.name: release_family
function.description: This function releases a font family by decreasing its reference count. If the reference count reaches zero, it ensures that the list of faces is empty, removes the family from the family name tree and the family second name tree (if it has a second name), releases the replacement family (if it exists), and finally frees the memory allocated to the family.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the font family that is to be released.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value.

function.name: find_family_from_name
function.description: This function searches for a font family by its name in the family_name_tree. If it doesn't find any, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: This is the name of the font family to be searched in the family_name_tree.

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_family. It represents the font family found with the given name. If no font family is found, it returns NULL.

function.name: find_family_from_any_name
function.description: This function is used to find a font family from any given name. It first tries to find the family from the name directly, if not found, it tries to get it from the family_second_name_tree. If still not found, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: This is the name of the font family to be found.

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_family. This represents the font family found. If not found, it returns NULL.

function.name: find_face_from_full_name
function.description: This function is used to find a font face from a given full name. It searches the face_full_name_tree for the provided full name. If it finds a match, it returns the corresponding font face. If it doesn't find a match, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: full_name
parameters.description: This is the full name of the font face that the function is trying to find.

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_face pointer. It represents the found font face. If no font face is found, it returns NULL.

function.name: get_family_face_list
function.description: This function returns a list of faces from a given font family. If the font family has a replacement, it returns the replacement's faces; otherwise, it returns the family's faces.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the font family from which the list of faces is to be obtained.

function.return_type: struct list. This represents a list of faces from the given font family or its replacement.

function.name: family_find_face_from_filename
function.description: This function searches for a font face within a given font family based on the provided file name. It increments the reference count of the found font face before returning it.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Pointer to the font family where the function will search for the font face.

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description: Name of the file to be searched within the font family.

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_face * - Returns a pointer to the found font face. If no font face is found, the function returns NULL.

function.name: find_face_from_filename
function.description: This function is used to find a font face from a given file name and family name. If no family name is provided, it searches through all families. If a family name is provided, it searches only within that family.

parameters.name: file_name
parameters.description: The name of the file to search for the font face

parameters.name: family_name
parameters.description: The name of the font family to search within. If this is NULL, the function searches all families.

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_face * - A pointer to the found font face. If no face is found, the function returns NULL.

function.name: add_family_replacement
function.description: This function adds a new font family replacement. If the replacement or new family does not exist, or if the family already has a replacement, the function will return false. Otherwise, it will create a new family, set its replacement to the existing family, increment the family's refcount, and return true. It also handles the case of vertical fonts.

parameters.name: new_name
parameters.description: The name of the new font family to be created

parameters.name: replace
parameters.description: The name of the existing font family to be replaced

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the family replacement was added successfully, FALSE otherwise

function.name: load_gdi_font_replacements
function.description: This function loads the GDI font replacements from the registry. It iterates through the registry keys, checks if the font replacement is available, and if not, it adds the replacement.
function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: dump_gdi_font_list
function.description: This function traverses through a list of font families and their faces, printing their details for debugging purposes.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value.

function.name: enum_fallbacks
function.description: This function determines the default font list based on the pitch and family, converts the default font to unicode, and returns a boolean value based on the index.

parameters.name: pitch_and_family
parameters.description: This parameter is used to determine the pitch and family of the font.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: This parameter is used to access the specific font from the default font list.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: This parameter is used to store the unicode converted font.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the function was able to successfully determine the default font and convert it to unicode or not.

function.name: set_default_family
function.description: This function sets the default family by iterating through fallbacks, removing the existing entry from the family_name_tree, copying the name to the default_name, and then reinserting the entry back into the family_name_tree.

parameters.name: pitch_and_family
parameters.description: This parameter is used to enumerate fallbacks.

parameters.name: default_name
parameters.description: This parameter is used to store the default family name.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value.

function.name: reorder_font_list
function.description: This function sets the default family for different font types.
function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: release_face
function.description: This function releases the resources associated with a given font face. It decreases the reference count of the face, and if the count reaches zero, it removes the face from the cache (if it was added to it), removes it from the list, and releases the associated family. It also removes the face from the full name tree (if it is present there), and frees the memory allocated for the file, style name, full name, cached enum data, and the face itself.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the font face structure that needs to be released.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: remove_font
function.description: This function removes a font face that matches the given file and flags from the font family. It locks the font family to ensure thread safety during the operation, and increments a counter for each face removed.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: This is the file name of the font face to be removed.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: These are the flags associated with the font face to be removed.

function.return_type: int, representing the number of font faces removed from the font family.

function.name: faces_equal
function.description: This function compares two gdi_font_face structures to check if they are equal. It first compares the full names of the faces, then checks if the first face is scalable. If it is, it returns true. If not, it checks if the sizes of the faces are equal. If they are not, it returns false. Finally, it compares the fs fields of the faces using memcmp.

parameters.name: f1
parameters.description: Pointer to the first gdi_font_face structure to be compared

parameters.name: f2
parameters.description: Pointer to the second gdi_font_face structure to be compared

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the faces are equal, FALSE otherwise

function.name: style_order
function.description: This function determines the style order of a font face based on its flags. It returns an integer representing the order.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a gdi_font_face structure. It represents the font face whose style order is to be determined.

function.return_type: int, representing the style order of the font face. 0 for regular, 1 for bold, 2 for italic, 3 for bold and italic, and 9999 for unknown flags.

function.name: insert_face_in_family_list
function.description: This function inserts a font face into a font family list. It checks if the face is already in the list and updates the reference count and version accordingly. If the face is not in the list, it adds it and updates the reference count.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: The font face to be inserted into the list

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: The font family list where the face will be inserted

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the face was successfully inserted or updated in the list, FALSE otherwise

parameters.name: second_name

parameters.name: fullname
parameters.description: The full name of the font

function.name: load_face_from_cache
function.description: This function loads a font face from the cache. It also handles the loading of bitmap strikes.

parameters.name: hkey_family
parameters.description: Handle to a registry key for the font family

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Pointer to a gdi_font_family structure

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer where the function stores temporary data

parameters.name: buffer_size
parameters.description: Size of the buffer

parameters.name: scalable
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating whether the font face is scalable or not

function.return_type: void

function.name: add_face_to_cache
function.description: This function adds a font face to the cache. It then initializes a cached_face structure with the properties of the font face and sets the registry value for the style name. Finally, it closes the registry keys.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the font face structure that needs to be added to the cache.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value

function.description: This function removes a font face from the cache. If the font face is not scalable, it deletes the key associated with the font size. If the font face is scalable, it deletes the value associated with the font style. The function operates on the Windows registry.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the font face structure that is to be removed from the cache.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.description: This function searches for a gdi font link that matches the given name. It iterates over the list of font links and compares each link's name with the provided name. If it finds a match, it returns that link. If no match is found, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: This is the name of the gdi font link to be found.

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_link * - This represents a pointer to the found gdi font link. If no link is found, it returns NULL.

function.name: find_family_from_font_links
function.description: This function searches for a font family in the font links list using the provided name and substitute name. It also checks for font signature compatibility. If a match is found, it returns the corresponding font family; otherwise, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the font family to search for in the font links list.

parameters.name: subst
parameters.description: A substitute name for the font family, used if the original name does not yield a match.

parameters.name: fs
parameters.description: The font signature to check for compatibility with the font family.

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_family *; Returns a pointer to the matched font family if found, otherwise returns NULL.

function.name: add_gdi_font_link
function.description: This function is used to add a new GDI font link. If the font link already exists, it returns the existing link. Otherwise, it creates a new link, initializes it, and adds it to the tail of the font links list.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: This is the name of the GDI font link to be added.

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_link *; It represents a pointer to the added or found GDI font link.

function.name: add_gdi_font_link_entry
function.description: This function adds a new entry to the gdi font link. It allocates memory for the new entry, copies the family name into the new entry, assigns the font signature, updates the font signature in the link, and finally adds the new entry to the link's list of entries.

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: This is the link to which the new entry will be added.

parameters.name: family_name
parameters.description: This is the family name that will be copied into the new entry.

parameters.name: fs
parameters.description: This is the font signature that will be assigned to the new entry and used to update the link's font signature.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return anything.

function.name: populate_system_links
function.description: This function populates system links for a given font family. It ignores fonts that are only substitutes for other fonts. For each value in the values array, it compares the name with the value, gets the font substitution if it exists, finds the font family from the value, and adds a font link entry for the first extant filename for the family.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: This parameter represents the name of the font family.

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an array of values to be processed for the given font family.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value but performs operations on the provided parameters.

function.name: load_system_links
function.description: This function loads system links for fonts. It opens a registry key and enumerates its values, adding font links for each value that is not a substitute for another font. It also handles special cases for the MS Shell Dlg font and the system font.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: translate_charset_info
function.description: This function translates charset information based on the provided flags. It iterates over the charset_info array and checks for matching conditions based on the flag type. If a match is found, it assigns the matching charset_info to the CHARSETINFO pointer and returns TRUE. If no match is found, it returns FALSE.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Pointer to the source DWORD. Depending on the flag, it represents either a font signature, a code page, or a charset.

parameters.name: cs
parameters.description: Pointer to a CHARSETINFO structure. If a match is found, the function assigns the matching charset_info to this pointer.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flag that determines the type of the source DWORD. It can be TCI_SRCFONTSIG for a font signature, TCI_SRCCODEPAGE for a code page, or TCI_SRCCHARSET for a charset.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether a match was found in the charset_info array. Returns TRUE if a match is found, FALSE otherwise.

function.name: can_select_face
function.description: This function determines if a specific font face can be selected based on its scalability, font signature, and the ability to use bitmap.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Pointer to the font face structure to be selected

parameters.name: fs
parameters.description: Font signature of the font face

parameters.name: can_use_bitmap
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating if bitmap can be used or not

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the font face can be selected, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: find_best_matching_face
function.description: This function finds the best matching font face from a given font family, based on the provided font signature, logfont, and a boolean indicating whether bitmap can be used or not.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Pointer to the font family from which the best matching face is to be found

parameters.name: lf
parameters.description: Pointer to the logical font structure containing font attributes

parameters.name: fs
parameters.description: Font signature containing information about the character sets supported by the font

parameters.name: can_use_bitmap
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating whether bitmap can be used or not

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_face * - Pointer to the best matching font face. If no matching face is found, it returns NULL

function.name: find_matching_face_by_name
function.description: This function searches for a matching font face by its name. If a substitute name is provided, it will be used in case the original name doesn't match any font face. The function also considers the font signature, whether bitmap can be used, and the original name of the font face.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the font face to search for

parameters.name: subst
parameters.description: The substitute name to use if the original name doesn't match any font face

parameters.name: lf
parameters.description: The logical font structure

parameters.name: fs
parameters.description: The font signature

parameters.name: can_use_bitmap
parameters.description: A flag indicating whether bitmap can be used

parameters.name: orig_name
parameters.description: The original name of the font face

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_face * - A pointer to the matching font face structure if found, NULL otherwise

function.name: find_any_face
function.description: This function tries to find a font face that matches the given criteria. It first tries to find a match in the family fallbacks. If no match is found, it tries to find a scalable match. If still no match is found and bitmap fonts can be used, it tries to find a bitmap match. If no match is found in any of these steps, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: lf
parameters.description: Pointer to a LOGFONTW structure that contains information about the logical font

parameters.name: fs
parameters.description: Font signature, used to match the font

parameters.name: can_use_bitmap
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether bitmap fonts can be used

parameters.name: want_vertical
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether a vertical font is desired

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_face *: Pointer to a gdi_font_face structure that represents the found font face. If no matching font face is found, the function returns NULL.

function.name: find_matching_face
function.description: This function finds a matching font face based on the provided parameters. It checks for charset translation, font substitution, and if necessary, tries to find any face matching the criteria. If no matching face is found, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: lf
parameters.description: Pointer to a LOGFONTW structure that defines the logical font

parameters.name: csi
parameters.description: Pointer to a CHARSETINFO structure that defines the character set information

parameters.name: can_use_bitmap
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating whether bitmap can be used

parameters.name: substituted
parameters.description: Pointer to a boolean value indicating whether a substitution has been made

parameters.name: orig_name
parameters.description: Pointer to the original name of the font face

function.return_type: struct gdi_font_face *: Pointer to a gdi_font_face structure representing the matching font face. Returns NULL if no matching face is found.

function.name: handle_entry
function.description: This function takes a handle, calculates an index from it, and returns a pointer to the font handle entry at that index if it exists and matches the generation of the handle. If the handle is invalid, it logs a warning and returns NULL.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This parameter represents a handle to a font.

function.return_type: struct font_handle_entry pointer. It represents a pointer to a font handle entry if the handle is valid and matches the generation, otherwise NULL.

function.name: get_font_from_handle
function.description: This function retrieves a font from a given handle. If the handle is invalid, it sets the last win32 error to ERROR_INVALID_PARAMETER and returns NULL.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is the handle used to retrieve the font.

function.return_type: struct gdi_font pointer. It represents the font associated with the given handle. If the handle is invalid, the function returns NULL.

function.name: alloc_font_handle
function.description: This function allocates a font handle. It either gets the next free entry or uses the next unused one. If all font handles are used, it returns an error and a 0. It also manages the generation of the font handle entries.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: This parameter is used to assign a font to the font handle entry.

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the font handle. If no handles are available, it returns 0.

function.name: free_font_handle
function.description: This function frees a font handle by setting its entry's font to the next free entry and then setting the next free entry to the current entry.

parameters.name: handle
parameters.description: This is the handle of the font to be freed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: alloc_gdi_font
function.description: This function allocates memory for a new gdi_font structure, initializes its fields, and returns a pointer to it. If a file is provided, it queries its attributes and copies them into the structure. Otherwise, it uses the provided data pointer and size.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: Pointer to a wide-character string representing the file name. If this parameter is NULL, the function uses the data_ptr and data_size parameters instead.

parameters.name: data_ptr
parameters.description: Pointer to the data to be used if the file parameter is NULL.

parameters.name: data_size
parameters.description: Size of the data to be used if the file parameter is NULL.

function.return_type: struct gdi_font * - Pointer to the newly allocated and initialized gdi_font structure.

function.name: free_gdi_font
function.description: This function is used to free the memory allocated for a gdi_font structure and its associated properties. It also handles the destruction of the font if it's private, and recursively frees any child fonts.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the gdi_font structure that needs to be freed.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return any value

function.name: get_gdi_font_name
function.description: This function returns the name of the GDI font. It checks if the 'use_logfont_name' attribute of the font is true, if so it returns the 'lfFaceName' attribute of the 'lf' object of the font. Otherwise, it returns the 'otmpFamilyName' attribute of the 'otm' object of the font.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the GDI font structure from which the font name is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: WCHAR. This represents the name of the GDI font.

function.name: create_gdi_font
function.description: This function creates a new gdi_font structure, initializes it with the provided parameters and returns a pointer to it.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Pointer to a gdi_font_face structure that provides the font face details

parameters.name: family_name
parameters.description: Pointer to a string representing the family name of the font

parameters.name: lf
parameters.description: Pointer to a LOGFONTW structure that provides the logical font details

function.return_type: struct gdi_font *; Pointer to the newly created gdi_font structure

function.name: get_gdi_font_glyph_metrics
function.description: This function retrieves the glyph metrics for a specified font and index. If the metrics are cached, it assigns them to the provided pointers and returns TRUE, otherwise it returns FALSE.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: Pointer to the font structure from which to retrieve the glyph metrics

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index of the glyph for which to retrieve the metrics

parameters.name: gm
parameters.description: Pointer to a GLYPHMETRICS structure that will receive the glyph metrics

parameters.name: abc
parameters.description: Pointer to an ABC structure that will receive the glyph metrics

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the glyph metrics were successfully retrieved and assigned, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: set_gdi_font_glyph_metrics
function.description: This function sets the glyph metrics for a given font, index, and ABC structure. It reallocates memory for the glyph metrics if needed and initializes the glyph metrics and ABC structure for the given index.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: Pointer to the gdi_font structure for which the glyph metrics are to be set

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index at which the glyph metrics are to be set

parameters.name: gm
parameters.description: Pointer to the GLYPHMETRICS structure that contains the glyph metrics to be set

parameters.name: abc
parameters.description: Pointer to the ABC structure that contains the abc values to be set

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: get_GSUB_vert_feature
function.description: This function retrieves the 'GSUB' vertical feature from a given font. It checks for 'vrt2' and 'vert' features in the font's 'GSUB' table and returns the feature if found. If not found, it frees the allocated memory and returns NULL.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: A pointer to the font structure from which the 'GSUB' vertical feature is to be retrieved.

function.return_type: void *: Returns a pointer to the 'GSUB' vertical feature if found, otherwise returns NULL.

function.name: GSUB_is_glyph_covered
function.description: This function checks if a glyph is covered in a given table. It handles two coverage formats and returns the index of the glyph if it is covered, otherwise it returns -1.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: A pointer to the table where the glyph is to be searched.

parameters.name: glyph
parameters.description: The glyph that is to be checked for coverage in the table.

function.return_type: int, represents the index of the glyph in the table if it is covered, otherwise -1.

function.name: GSUB_apply_feature
function.description: This function applies a specific feature to a glyph in a GSUB header. It iterates over the lookups in the feature, and for each lookup, it applies the substitution specified in the lookup to the glyph if the glyph is covered by the lookup.

parameters.name: header
parameters.description: Pointer to the GSUB header where the feature is to be applied.

parameters.name: feature
parameters.description: Pointer to the feature to be applied.

parameters.name: glyph
parameters.description: The glyph to which the feature is to be applied.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the glyph after the feature has been applied.

function.name: get_GSUB_vert_glyph
function.description: This function checks if the glyph is null or if the gsub_table of the font is null, it returns the glyph. Otherwise, it applies the vert_feature of the font to the glyph using the GSUB_apply_feature function.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the gdi_font structure which contains the font details.

parameters.name: glyph
parameters.description: This is the glyph that needs to be checked and possibly transformed.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the possibly transformed glyph.

function.name: add_child_font
function.description: This function creates a child font for a given font and adds it to the list of child fonts. It also copies the properties of the base font to the child font.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: This is the base font for which a child font is to be created.

parameters.name: family_name
parameters.description: This is the family name of the font face to be used for creating the child font.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return anything. It modifies the base font by adding a child font to it.

function.name: create_child_font_list
function.description: This function creates a list of child fonts for a given font. It first checks if the font is in the system list. If it is, it adds all the child fonts to the font. If the font's charset is not SYMBOL or OEM, it also adds Microsoft Sans Serif and all its fonts, and Tahoma and all its fonts as a backup.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: This is the font for which the child font list is to be created.

function.return_type: void, as this function does not return anything. It modifies the font by adding child fonts to it.

function.name: fontcmp
function.description: This function compares the properties of a given font with the specified parameters. It checks the hash, matrix, logfont, and bitmap usage of the font. If any of these properties do not match, it returns TRUE. If all properties match, it compares the face name of the font and returns the result.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: Pointer to the font structure to be compared

parameters.name: hash
parameters.description: The hash value to be compared with the font's hash

parameters.name: lf
parameters.description: Pointer to the LOGFONTW structure to be compared with the font's LOGFONTW

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to the FMAT2 structure to be compared with the font's matrix

parameters.name: can_use_bitmap
parameters.description: Boolean value to be compared with the font's bitmap usage

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if any of the font's properties do not match the specified parameters, otherwise it returns the result of comparing the face name of the font

function.name: hash_font
function.description: This function calculates and returns a hash value for a given font, based on its LOGFONTW structure, FMAT2 matrix, and a boolean value indicating whether a bitmap can be used or not.

parameters.name: lf
parameters.description: Pointer to a LOGFONTW structure that defines the font

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to a FMAT2 structure that defines the transformation matrix for the font

parameters.name: can_use_bitmap
parameters.description: Boolean value indicating whether a bitmap can be used for the font or not

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the hash value for the given font

function.name: cache_gdi_font
function.description: This function caches a gdi font, updates its cache number and hash, and adds it to the gdi font list.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the gdi font to be cached.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: find_cached_gdi_font
function.description: This function searches for a cached GDI font based on the provided parameters. If found, it removes the font from its current position in the list and adds it to the head of the list. If the font's reference count is zero, it also removes the font from the unused list and decrements the unused font count. If the font is not found, it returns NULL.

parameters.name: lf
parameters.description: Pointer to a LOGFONTW structure that defines the logical attributes of the font.

parameters.name: matrix
parameters.description: Pointer to a FMAT2 structure that defines the transformation matrix for the font.

parameters.name: can_use_bitmap
parameters.description: Boolean value that indicates whether the font can use a bitmap.

function.return_type: struct gdi_font *; Returns a pointer to the found cached GDI font, or NULL if the font is not found.

function.name: release_gdi_font
function.description: This function releases a GDI font, adds it to the unused list if its reference count is zero, and frees it if the unused font count exceeds the cache size.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the GDI font structure to be released.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: add_font_list
function.description: This function sets the registry values for different font types based on the provided parameters.

parameters.name: hkey
parameters.description: A handle to an open registry key.

parameters.name: fl
parameters.description: A pointer to a structure that contains font information.

parameters.name: dpi
parameters.description: The dots per inch (dpi) setting for the fonts.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: set_value_key
function.description: This function sets a value to a registry key. If the value is null, it deletes the value associated with the name.

parameters.name: hkey
parameters.description: This is a handle to an open registry key.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: This is the name of the value to be set. If value is null, this is the name of the value to be deleted.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: This is the value to be set to the registry key. If this is null, the function deletes the value associated with the name.

function.return_type: void, meaning it does not return any value

function.name: update_font_association_info
function.description: This function updates the font association information. If the maximum character size of ansi_cp is 2, it creates a registry key and sets certain values based on the code page of ansi_cp. If the maximum character size is not 2, it deletes a registry tree.
function.return_type: void, meaning it does not return anything

function.name: set_multi_value_key
function.description: This function sets a multi-value key in the registry. If the value is null, it deletes the registry value.

parameters.name: hkey
parameters.description: Handle to an open registry key.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Pointer to a null-terminated string specifying the name of the registry value.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer that contains the new data for the registry value.

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: Size of the data pointed by 'value' parameter.

function.return_type: void, does not return a value

function.name: update_font_system_link_info
function.description: This function updates the system link information for fonts. It creates a registry key and sets multiple values for it based on the default system link array. The function also handles locale-dependent links and adjusts the link and length accordingly.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, meaning this function does not return any value.

function.name: update_codepage
function.description: This function updates the codepage and font information based on the screen DPI. It checks the registry for existing values, updates them if necessary, and creates new registry keys for font information if they do not exist. It also handles font substitution for different locales.

parameters.name: screen_dpi
parameters.description: The screen DPI (dots per inch) value used to update the codepage and font information.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: font_CreateDC
function.description: This function creates a device context for a font, allocating memory for the font physical device and pushing the device context driver to the stack.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: Pointer to the physical device.

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Wide string representing the device.

parameters.name: output
parameters.description: Wide string representing the output.

parameters.name: devmode
parameters.description: Pointer to the device mode.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the device context was successfully created and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: font_DeleteDC
function.description: This function deletes a device context related to a font. It first retrieves the font device, releases the GDI font and then frees the memory allocated to the font device.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: This parameter is a device context for the font to be deleted.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE after successfully deleting the font device context.

function.name: is_complex_script_ansi_cp
function.description: This function checks if the code page of ansi_cp is Thai, Hebrew, or Arabic.
function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the code page of ansi_cp is Thai, Hebrew, or Arabic, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: create_enum_charset_list
function.description: This function creates a list of character sets. If the charset is valid, it sets the list's mask, charset, and script. If the charset is DEFAULT_CHARSET or invalid, it sets the current codepage's charset as the first element and fills out the remaining elements. It also adds a catch-all mask for remaining bits.

parameters.name: charset
parameters.description: The character set to be translated

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Pointer to the list where the character sets will be stored

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the number of elements in the list

function.name: get_font_type
function.description: This function determines the type of font based on the 'tmPitchAndFamily' attribute of the 'ntmTm' structure within the 'ntm' parameter. It checks for TrueType, Device, and Raster font types.

parameters.name: ntm
parameters.description: Pointer to a NEWTEXTMETRICEXW structure that contains information about the font.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the type of font. It could be TrueType, Device, Raster or a combination of these.

function.name: get_face_enum_data
function.description: This function retrieves the enumeration data for a given font face. It creates a GDI font, loads it, sets its metrics, and copies these metrics and other properties to the provided ENUMLOGFONTEXW and NEWTEXTMETRICEXW structures.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Pointer to the font face structure from which to retrieve enumeration data

parameters.name: elf
parameters.description: Pointer to the ENUMLOGFONTEXW structure where the function will store the enumeration data

parameters.name: ntm
parameters.description: Pointer to the NEWTEXTMETRICEXW structure where the function will store the new text metrics

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully retrieves the enumeration data and FALSE otherwise

function.name: family_matches
function.description: This function checks if the provided face name matches with the family name or any of the face names in the given font family.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the font family structure to be checked.

parameters.name: face_name
parameters.description: This is the face name to be compared with the family name and face names in the font family.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the face name matches with the family name or any of the face names in the font family, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: face_matches
function.description: This function compares the family name and full name of a font face with a given face name. If either matches, it returns TRUE, otherwise FALSE.

parameters.name: family_name
parameters.description: This is the family name of the font face to be compared.

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: This is the font face structure that contains the full name of the font face to be compared.

parameters.name: face_name
parameters.description: This is the face name to be compared with the family name and full name of the font face.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the face name matches either the family name or the full name of the font face, otherwise returns FALSE.

function.name: enum_face_charsets
function.description: This function enumerates the character sets of a given font face. It also handles font replacement and performs a callback operation for each character set.

parameters.name: family
parameters.description: Pointer to the font family structure

parameters.name: face
parameters.description: Pointer to the font face structure

parameters.name: list
parameters.description: Pointer to the character set enumeration structure

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The count of character sets

parameters.name: proc
parameters.description: Callback function to be called for each enumerated character set

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Parameter to be passed to the callback function

parameters.name: subst
parameters.description: Pointer to the substitution string in case of font replacement

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function successfully enumerates all character sets, FALSE otherwise

function.name: font_EnumFonts
function.description: This function enumerates fonts based on the provided parameters. It locks the font, checks if the font family and face match the given parameters, and if they do, it enumerates the face charsets. If the enumeration fails, it unlocks the font and returns FALSE. If all enumerations are successful, it unlocks the font and returns TRUE.

parameters.name: dev
parameters.description: Device context

parameters.name: lf
parameters.description: Pointer to a LOGFONTW structure that contains information about the logical font

parameters.name: proc
parameters.description: Callback function for each enumerated font

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Application-defined value

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if all enumerations are successful, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: check_unicode_tategaki
function.description: This function checks if a given unicode character has vertical orientation. It uses a predefined table to determine the orientation of the character.

parameters.name: ch
parameters.description: This is the unicode character that is being checked for vertical orientation.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the orientation of the character is either 1 or 3, indicating vertical orientation, and FALSE otherwise.

function.name: get_glyph_index_symbol
function.description: This function adjusts the glyph value based on certain conditions and retrieves the glyph index from the font using the font_funcs object. If the index is not found, it tries to retrieve the index again after adjusting the glyph value.

parameters.name: font
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the gdi_font structure which represents the font from which the glyph index is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: glyph
parameters.description: This is the glyph value for which the index is to be retrieved from the font.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the index of the glyph in the font. If the index is not found, it returns the adjusted glyph value.

function.name: get_cptable
function.description: This function retrieves a code page table corresponding to a given code page identifier. It first checks if the code page is ANSI or UTF-8, returning the corresponding table if so. If not, it searches an array of tables for the specified code page. If the code page is not found and the array is not full, it attempts to initialize a new table with the code page data.

parameters.name: cp
parameters.description: This is the code page identifier for which the function will retrieve a code page table.

function.return_type: CPTABLEINFO pointer. This represents a pointer to the code page table corresponding to the given code page identifier. If the code page is not found or cannot be initialized, the function returns NULL.

function.name: get_locale_data
function.description: This function retrieves locale-specific data based on a given locale identifier (LCID). It initializes NLS files if they are not already initialized, and then uses a binary search to find the LCID in the locale table. If the LCID is found, the function returns a pointer to the corresponding locale data. If the LCID is not found, the function returns NULL.

parameters.name: lcid

function.description: This function retrieves the width of specified characters. The width is retrieved in logical units or device units, depending on a flag. It also handles the case where the characters are represented by their indices.

parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: first

parameters.name: last

parameters.name: chars
parameters.description: Pointer to the characters to get the width for.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags that specify how to retrieve the width.

parameters.name: buf
parameters.description: Buffer to store the retrieved widths.

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if the function succeeds, otherwise FALSE

function.name: get_glyph_bitmap
function.description: This function retrieves the bitmap of a glyph from a specified device context. It uses the NtGdiGetGlyphOutline function to get the glyph outline and stores it in the provided image structure. If the glyph is empty, it sets the metrics to 0. If memory allocation for the image fails, it returns an error.

parameters.name: hdc

parameters.name: flags

parameters.name: metrics

parameters.name: image

function.return_type: DWORD. It returns ERROR_SUCCESS if the function succeeds. If the glyph is not found, it returns ERROR_NOT_FOUND. If memory allocation fails, it returns ERROR_OUTOFMEMORY.

function.name: get_line_width
function.description: This function calculates the absolute width of a line based on a given metric size. If the width is zero, it sets it to one. If the metric size is negative, it negates the width.

parameters.name: metric_size
parameters.description: This parameter represents the metric size of the line. If it's negative, the width will also be negative.

function.name: NtGdiExtTextOutW
function.description: This function is used to draw text using specified font, background color, and text color. It also provides options for controlling the layout and alignment, and for setting intercharacter spacing.

parameters.name: hdc
parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: x
parameters.description: The x-coordinate, in logical units, of the reference point used to position the string.

parameters.name: y
parameters.description: The y-coordinate, in logical units, of the reference point used to position the string.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies how to use the application-defined rectangle and how to interpret the string array.

parameters.name: lprect
parameters.description: Pointer to an optional rectangle structure that specifies dimensions, in logical units.

parameters.name: str
parameters.description: Pointer to the string to be drawn. The string does not need to be zero-terminated, since count specifies the length of the string.

parameters.name: count

parameters.name: lpDx
parameters.description: Pointer to an optional array of values that indicate the distance between origins of adjacent character cells.

parameters.name: cp
parameters.description: Specifies the code page used to perform the conversion.

function.return_type: BOOL. If the function succeeds, the return value is nonzero. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.description: This function retrieves the widths, in logical units, of consecutive characters in a specified range from the current font.

parameters.name: first

parameters.name: last

parameters.name: chars
parameters.description: A pointer to the buffer that receives the character widths.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: A flag that indicates the type of widths to retrieve.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: A pointer to the buffer that receives the widths.

function.description: This function retrieves the outline or bitmap for a character in the specified font.

parameters.description: Specifies the format of the data to be retrieved.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: Pointer to a GLYPHMETRICS structure that receives the metrics of the character.

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Specifies the size, in bytes, of the buffer.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to a buffer that receives the data.

parameters.name: mat2

parameters.name: ignore_rotation
parameters.description: Specifies whether to ignore rotation.

function.return_type: DWORD. If the function succeeds, the return value is the number of bytes required to store the character data. If the function fails, the return value is GDI_ERROR.

function.name: NtGdiMakeFontDir
function.description: This function creates a font directory with the specified parameters, locks the font, loads the font, sets the outline text metrics, checks if the font is TrueType, and then sets the font directory fields with the font metrics. If any of these operations fail, it frees the font and unlocks it, returning 0. If all operations are successful, it copies the font directory to the buffer, frees the font, unlocks it, and returns the face offset plus the position.

parameters.name: embed
parameters.description: Embedding level for the font

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Buffer to hold the font directory

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Size of the buffer

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the font file

parameters.name: len
parameters.description: Length of the path

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the face offset plus the position if all operations are successful, or 0 if any operation fails

function.name: NtGdiGetKerningPairs
function.description: This function retrieves the kerning pairs from the specified device context.

parameters.name: kern_pair
parameters.description: Pointer to an array of KERNINGPAIR structures that receives the kerning pairs.

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the number of kerning pairs retrieved. If the function fails, the return value is zero.

function.name: NtGdiGetFontData
function.description: This function retrieves font data for the specified device context.

parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: table
parameters.description: Specifies the table number.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Specifies the offset from the beginning of the table.

parameters.name: buffer
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer that receives the font data.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: Specifies the length, in bytes, of the data to be retrieved.

function.return_type: DWORD, represents the number of bytes returned if the function is successful, or GDI_ERROR if it fails.

parameters.name: count

parameters.name: indices
parameters.description: Pointer to the buffer that receives the glyph indices.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies the options for the function.

function.return_type: DWORD. It represents the number of glyphs written to the buffer. If the function fails, it returns GDI_ERROR.

function.name: add_system_font_resource
function.description: This function adds a system font resource from a specified file and with specified flags. It first tries to add the font from the Windows directory, and if that fails, it tries to add the font from the data directory.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: This is the file path of the font to be added.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: These are the flags to be used when adding the font.

function.return_type: int, represents the result of the font addition operation. A return value of 0 indicates that the operation was unsuccessful, while any other value indicates success.

function.name: remove_system_font_resource
function.description: This function removes a system font resource from the Windows directory and the data directory. It first tries to remove the font from the Windows directory. If that fails, it tries to remove it from the data directory.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The name of the font file to be removed

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags that specify the removal method

function.return_type: BOOL, returns a non-zero value if the font was successfully removed, and zero otherwise

function.name: add_font_resource
function.description: This function adds a font resource from a given file. If the file starts with a backslash, it adds the font to the cache unless the FR_PRIVATE flag is set. If the file does not contain a backslash, it adds the font as a system font resource.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The file path of the font resource to be added.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Flags to control the behavior of the font addition. FR_PRIVATE flag can be used to prevent adding the font to the cache.

function.return_type: int, represents the result of the font addition operation. A return value of 0 indicates success.

function.name: remove_font_resource
function.description: This function removes a font resource based on the provided file path and flags. If the file path starts with a backslash, it removes the font using the 'remove_font' function with specific flags. If the file path does not contain a backslash, it removes the system font resource using the 'remove_system_font_resource' function with specific flags.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: This is a long pointer to a constant wide string that represents the file path of the font resource to be removed.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: This is a 32-bit unsigned integer that represents the flags to be used when removing the font resource.

function.return_type: BOOL, represents whether the font resource was successfully removed or not.

function.name: load_system_bitmap_fonts
function.description: This function loads system bitmap fonts from the registry. It queries the registry for the font files 'FONTS.FON', 'OEMFONT.FON', 'FIXEDFON.FON' and adds them as system font resources if they exist and are of type REG_SZ.
function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: load_directory_fonts
function.description: This function loads the fonts from a given directory path. It opens the directory, queries for file information, and adds any non-directory files as fonts.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: This is the path to the directory from which the fonts will be loaded.

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: These are the flags that will be passed to the add_font function.

function.return_type: void, meaning this function does not return any value.

function.name: load_file_system_fonts
function.description: This function loads the system fonts from the Windows directory, Wine data directory, and custom paths specified in the Wine registry key.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: update_external_font_keys
function.description: This function updates the external font keys in the Windows registry. It enumerates the fonts and adds external ones to the two keys. It also handles the deletion and addition of registry values related to the fonts.
function.return_type: void, meaning it does not return anything

function.name: load_registry_fonts
function.description: This function loads fonts from the registry. It looks under HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows[ NT]\CurrentVersion\Fonts for any fonts not installed in %WINDOWSDIR%\Fonts. It also looks for any .fon fonts, since ReadFontDir will skip these.
function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: open_hkcu
function.description: This function opens a handle to the HKEY_CURRENT_USER registry key. It first gets the security identifier (SID) for the current user, then constructs a registry path string using this SID. This path is then passed to the reg_open_key function to open the registry key.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not accept any parameters.

function.return_type: HKEY, which is a handle to the opened registry key. If the function fails to get the current user's SID or to open the registry key, it returns 0.

function.name: font_init
function.description: This function initializes the font by setting up the necessary attributes, loading system and file system fonts, creating a mutex, and loading font substitutions and replacements. It also handles the creation of a registry key for font caching and loading fonts from the registry or cache as necessary.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: UINT, represents the DPI (dots per inch) of the initialized font. If the font initialization fails, it returns 0 or 96 depending on the failure point.

function.description: This function retrieves font file information for a given instance ID and file index. function.name: DrawTextW
function.description: This function is used to draw text on a device context. If the callback is successful, it updates the rectangle and returns the height of the drawn text.

parameters.description: Handle to the device context.

parameters.name: str

parameters.name: flags
parameters.description: Specifies method of formatting the text.

function.return_type: INT, represents the height of the drawn text. If the function fails, it returns 0.
